name: peakflow/peakflow
description: Invoicing, banking and the double-entry ledger underneath them.

suggest.ext-bcmath: Speeds up exact decimal arithmetic. brick/math falls back to a pure-PHP calculator without it, which is correct but slower - see docs/architecture/money-and-precision.md.
suggest.ext-redis: Cache, queue, rate limiting and the distributed locks that keep a two-node scheduler from double-billing.
suggest.rector/rector: Automated upgrades and dead-code removal. Not in require-dev because its Composer source could not be resolved in the build environment this was first assembled in; install it locally with `composer require --dev rector/rector` and run `composer rector`. rector.php is committed and ready.

dev: npx concurrently -c "#4169E1,#DC382D,#F7DF1E,#8892BF" "php artisan serve" "php artisan queue:listen --tries=1 --timeout=0" "npm run dev" "php artisan pail --timeout=0" --names=server,queue,vite,logs --kill-others

scripts-descriptions.setup: Take a fresh clone to a running application in one command.
scripts-descriptions.check: Everything the pipeline would run, locally. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
scripts-descriptions.test:arch: The rules that encode the non-negotiables: no float in the money path, entity_id on every financial table, Reporting never writes.
scripts-descriptions.verify: Architecture rules and the specification worked examples, with no test runner. Works where the dev dependencies cannot be installed.
